items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: it was probably Eric Clapton calling you “Ralph, what are you doing next week?”

ctx.x: You know what, I’m not going to even answer it. I don’t know who that is. I’ll shut it off.
I’ll bet I know who it was. We were talking about rock & roll, it was probably Eric Clapton calling you “Ralph, what are you doing next week?”
